Feature: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on full NPs?
curated_comment: SOLID. A = ERG 'e, P/S = ABS 'ia; canonical ergative-absolutive on full NPs (sec.4.2). Younger speakers may replace 'e with 'i (UNSP) or elide it.

Feature: Are the ergative and the genitive expressed by the same marker?
curated_comment: Ergative 'e and genitive/possessive 'a/'o are DISTINCT markers (sec.4.3). Not syncretic.

Feature: Are the ergative and the instrumental/comitative expressed by the same marker?
